mapper.update: INSERT INTO team_heat_stat (team_id, view_count, comment_count, apply_count, publish_score, total_score, update_time) VALUES (#{teamId}, 1, 0, 0, 10, 11, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + 1, total_score = total_score + 1, update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO team_heat_stat (team_id, view_count, comment_count, apply_count, publish_score, total_score, update_time) VALUES (#{teamId}, 0, 1, 0, 10, 13, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE comment_count = comment_count + 1, total_score = total_score + 3, update_time = NOW()

INSERT INTO team_heat_stat (team_id, view_count, comment_count, apply_count, publish_score, total_score, update_time) VALUES (#{teamId}, 0, 0, 1, 10, 15, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE apply_count = apply_count + 1, total_score = total_score + 5, update_time = NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_heat_stat (team_id, view_count, comment_count, apply_count, publish_score, total_score, update_time) SELECT t.team_id, 0, 0, 0, 10, 10, NOW() FROM team_recruit t LEFT JOIN team_heat_stat h ON h.team_id = t.team_id WHERE t.status = 1 AND h.team_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT h.team_id, h.view_count, h.comment_count, h.apply_count, h.publish_score, h.total_score, h.update_time FROM team_heat_stat h INNER JOIN team_recruit t ON t.team_id = h.team_id WHERE t.status = 1
